proof_requests: Clear photo of the rear panel and the model number sticker on the base of the console
A power-on video showing the PS4 home screen and the 'Console Information' system menu which states the model
Close-up photo of the UK receipt with legible date/serial, held next to the console's serial number
Close-up photos of the console's ports (HDMI, USB, power) and both controllers' sticks/buttons
A short clip of actual gameplay running without freezing or shutdown
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo does not change what the photo shows: the shell is a Star Wars special edition PS4, not a Pro, and no model plate, powered-on test, or receipt has been provided, so a worst-case price still cannot be fixed.
